type_or_definition: sip : (Fin 3 -> R) -> (Fin 3 -> R) -> R
mathematical_interpretation: The positive definite Euclidean inner product: the primitive datum of the project.
notes: No signature, no metric on a manifold and no orientation at this stage.
existence_note: The primitive local input of the project.

type_or_definition: LorentzCarrier := R x (Fin 3 -> R)
mathematical_interpretation: The spin-factor carrier: scalar part plus Euclidean vector part.
notes: Four-dimensional as a real vector space; it is not a tangent space.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: NS (x : LorentzCarrier) : R := x.1 ^ 2 - sip x.2 x.2
mathematical_interpretation: The intrinsic quadratic form; its signature is (1,3).
notes: Derived from the positive Euclidean datum by the spin-factor construction.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: BS (x y : LorentzCarrier) : R := (NS (x+y) - NS x - NS y)/2
mathematical_interpretation: The polarization of NS: the intrinsic Lorentz bilinear form transported by the solder.
notes: This is the form that becomes the tangent metric once a regular solder exists.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: the positive cone of the carrier
mathematical_interpretation: The intrinsic cone used to define the Lorentz group and the future-cone reductions.
notes: A cone condition, not a chosen time orientation of a manifold.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: the subgroup of linear self-equivalences preserving NS and the cone, of determinant 1
mathematical_interpretation: The project's own intrinsic Lorentz group.
notes: Defined intrinsically; it is not imported from, nor compared with, a Mathlib Lorentz group.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: q3 : QuadraticForm R (Fin 3 -> R)
mathematical_interpretation: The positive Euclidean quadratic form whose Clifford algebra is used.
notes: Positive, not Lorentzian: the Lorentz structure appears through the paravector embedding.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: Cl3 := CliffordAlgebra q3
mathematical_interpretation: The intrinsic Clifford algebra of the primitive Euclidean space.
notes: Its canonical topology is constructed in E1/Topology/CliffordTopology.lean.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: cle (i : Fin 3) : Cl3
mathematical_interpretation: The Clifford generators; they square to +1 and anticommute.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: spinToCl (x : LorentzCarrier) : Cl3
mathematical_interpretation: The paravector embedding of the carrier into the Clifford algebra; it realises NS as the Clifford norm.
notes: The bridge from Euclidean Clifford data to Lorentz signature.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: SpinGroup : Subgroup Cl3^x
mathematical_interpretation: The intrinsic Spin group of the project.
notes: No Lie-group package exists for it: this is the regularity boundary CLAIM-B001.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: spinCover : SpinGroup ->* GLor
mathematical_interpretation: The native projection, given by the twisted Clifford action; surjective with central kernel of order two.
notes: Every Lorentz-side object of the project is obtained through this map.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: the native instance of NullSectorTask28.InternalProjection
mathematical_interpretation: Packaging of the native projection for the generic Cech lifting theory.
notes: Local sections come from the explicit algebraic inversion of the twisted action.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: structure over a Cech cover with Spin-valued transition functions
mathematical_interpretation: The native Spin-side Cech transition datum; the only place where a deformation is introduced.
notes: Its projection is the visible Lorentz cocycle; there is no independent Lorentz-side datum.
existence_note: The native Spin Cech transition datum is supplied over the emergent cover; the type is constructed from the intrinsic Spin group, an instance is an input.

type_or_definition: the value of the projected cocycle at a point, as a linear equivalence of the local model
mathematical_interpretation: The internal Lorentz transition seen by the solder square.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: kernel-valued fixed-cover gauge equivalence of native Spin data
mathematical_interpretation: Identifies two Spin lifts of one and the same projected Lorentz cocycle.
notes: Strictly finer than the full-group notion OBJ-039; the two must not be conflated.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: structure: pieces, chart domains D i, incidence domains W i j, gluing maps phi i j with a cocycle law
mathematical_interpretation: The additional global datum: how local four-dimensional pieces are identified.
regularity: topological; smoothness is an extra predicate
notes: Not derivable from the local core (CLAIM-G001).
existence_note: The base gluing is an input of the global layer and is provably not derivable from the local core (CLAIM-G001).

type_or_definition: Space B := Quotient B.setoid
mathematical_interpretation: The emergent base: the glued topological space, charted over the local model.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: the predicate that all gluing maps are C-infinity
mathematical_interpretation: The smooth gate on the primitive.
notes: An assumption on the datum; the module also contains a continuous-only counterexample.
existence_note: The smoothness predicate/certificate of the base gluing is an extra hypothesis on the supplied global datum; it is not derived from the local core, and dropping it has an explicit counterexample (CLAIM-G003).

type_or_definition: the four-dimensional local model, carrying localModelI
mathematical_interpretation: The model space of the emergent manifold, identified with the carrier as a vector space.
notes: The identification is a modelling choice; tangent spaces are still Mathlib's genuine ones.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: D(phi_ij) as a continuous linear equivalence
mathematical_interpretation: The genuine tangent transition of the emergent atlas.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: the vector-bundle core built from the projected Lorentz cocycle
mathematical_interpretation: The internal Lorentz bundle of a native Spin datum.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: structure: fibrewise frames with the projected-transition overlap law
mathematical_interpretation: The weak (fibrewise) solder: the coupling primitive without regularity.
notes: Provably insufficient for tangent geometry (CLAIM-G007).
existence_note: The weak solder is an additional comparison datum between the internal Lorentz bundle and the tangent bundle. The type is constructed; inhabitance is not derived.

type_or_definition: structure: A : iota -> LocalModel -> (LocalModel ~L LocalModel), C-infinity on each chart domain, with the exact intertwining square
mathematical_interpretation: The regular solder: the decisive bridge between internal Lorentz data and tangent geometry.
notes: Existence is a gate: it can fail (CLAIM-G017) and is not implied by anything else.
existence_note: The regular solder is the decisive additional global gate datum. The type is constructed; inhabitance is NOT derived and provably fails on the Moebius-type control (CLAIM-G017, CLAIM-B007, OP-011).

type_or_definition: the fibrewise bilinear form transported from BS through the solder
mathematical_interpretation: The induced tangent Lorentz metric.
notes: Chart independent because two frames differ by an element of GLor.
existence_note: Defined for a given solder; its existence is conditional on a solder being given (CLAIM-B007).

type_or_definition: the metric coefficients in chart coordinates
mathematical_interpretation: The chart-coordinate form of the induced metric, where smoothness and signature are proved.
existence_note: Defined for a given regular solder; conditional on the solder gate (CLAIM-B007).

type_or_definition: the group of regular chartwise gauge fields
mathematical_interpretation: The exact residual freedom of the solder: it acts freely and transitively.
existence_note: The gauge group itself always exists (the identity gauge); it acts freely and transitively on the regular solder solution space, whose non-emptiness is a gate (CLAIM-B007).

type_or_definition: structure: a coherent chartwise future-cone choice
mathematical_interpretation: The project-native time-orientation datum produced by a regular solder.
notes: Not proved equivalent to standard time-orientability (CLAIM-B006).
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: the periodic fixed-cover base gluing, parameterized by a label type and a wrap involution
mathematical_interpretation: The frozen control geometry: two slabs per loop glued along two disjoint incidence components.
notes: Not proved homeomorphic to S^1 x R^3 (CLAIM-B004).
existence_note: An explicitly constructed control instance; nothing general follows from it.

type_or_definition: the orientation-reversing instance of the same family
mathematical_interpretation: The adversarial model on which no regular solder exists.
existence_note: An explicitly constructed control instance; nothing general follows from it.

type_or_definition: transportState : R -> SpinGroup
mathematical_interpretation: The single shared native Spin-side one-parameter subgroup generating the tested deformation. It is built from the specifically selected Clifford direction SpinCore.cle 0 (SharedTransport.lean: transportElem l = cosh(l/2) + sinh(l/2) . cle 0), hence from one chosen spatial generator.
selection_note: A deliberately selected control slice: the family is generated by the chosen Clifford direction SpinCore.cle 0. No theorem says that this direction is canonical, that it is singled out by the primitive Euclidean input, or that the family exhausts the native Spin deformation directions.
notes: Not a connection, a transport form or a holonomy; and not a canonical or exhaustive deformation direction — see selection_note.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: projectedTransportState l := spinCover (transportState l)
mathematical_interpretation: The Lorentz-side value of the deformation; derived only through the native projection of the selected cle-0 family.
selection_note: A deliberately selected control slice: the family is generated by the chosen Clifford direction SpinCore.cle 0. No theorem says that this direction is canonical, that it is singled out by the primitive Euclidean input, or that the family exhausts the native Spin deformation directions.
notes: See selection_note: selected cle-0 control direction.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: paraMap l : LocalModel ->L LocalModel := id + (cosh l - 1) paraPlane + sinh l paraSwap
mathematical_interpretation: The closed form of the projected transport state of the selected cle-0 family; smooth in the parameter.
selection_note: A deliberately selected control slice: the family is generated by the chosen Clifford direction SpinCore.cle 0. No theorem says that this direction is canonical, that it is singled out by the primitive Euclidean input, or that the family exhausts the native Spin deformation directions.
notes: A computed closed form of an already certified object, not a new datum. See selection_note: selected cle-0 control direction.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: the deformed native Spin transition datum of the periodic control
mathematical_interpretation: The tested one-parameter family of Cech transition cocycles.
notes: At the neutral value it is exactly the frozen Task-36 trivial seed.
existence_note: An explicitly constructed control instance; nothing general follows from it.

type_or_definition: structure with exactly the two fields smoothGluing and solder
mathematical_interpretation: A solution of the closure problem at a parameter value.
notes: The two-field shape is enforced by the deformation firewall: compatibility may never be a supplied field.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: the Task-37 closure observable specialised to the fixed control
mathematical_interpretation: The admissibility predicate whose locus the smoke test computes.
existence_note: An explicitly constructed control instance; nothing general follows from it.

type_or_definition: a C-infinity transition profile on the loop coordinate
mathematical_interpretation: The interpolation used both by the compensating solder and by the gauge transformation.
notes: It uses the coordinate gap between the two incidence components of the control.
existence_note: An explicitly constructed control instance; nothing general follows from it.

type_or_definition: the explicit compensating regular solder at each parameter value
mathematical_interpretation: The explicit certified regular solution branch of the smoke test.
existence_note: An explicitly constructed control instance; nothing general follows from it.

type_or_definition: full-group, continuity-carrying cocycle gauge equivalence on a fixed cover
mathematical_interpretation: The 'is this cocycle a coboundary' relation, with the project's own multiplication convention.
notes: Coarser than OBJ-016; the inclusion of the kernel-valued notion is proved, so the convention is not chosen by analogy.
existence_note: Constructed outright from the data listed in constructed_from.

type_or_definition: the chartwise Spin gauge exhibiting the deformed cocycle as a coboundary
mathematical_interpretation: The Spin-side gauge transformation of the smoke test.
notes: Its smoothness is not available: the intrinsic SpinGroup has no smooth structure.
existence_note: An explicitly constructed control instance; nothing general follows from it.

type_or_definition: the projected gauge in chart coordinates, paraMap at the negated interpolated parameter
mathematical_interpretation: The Lorentz-side gauge of the smoke test.
notes: Proved equal to the native projection of OBJ-040, so it is not an independent Lorentz-side object.
existence_note: An explicitly constructed control instance; nothing general follows from it.

type_or_definition: transport of an arbitrary regular solder solution along the projected gauge
mathematical_interpretation: The map realising the correspondence of regular solution spaces at two parameter values.
notes: Defined on the frozen control only; it preserves the induced tangent Lorentz metric.
existence_note: An explicitly constructed control instance; nothing general follows from it.

type_or_definition: gB : Submodule R (Module.End R LorentzCarrier); A in gB iff for all x y, BS (A x) y + BS x (A y) = 0
mathematical_interpretation: The intrinsic Lorentz-skew endomorphisms of the carrier: the project's own infinitesimal Lorentz sector, six-dimensional.
existence_note: Constructed from the carrier and its polarized form BS only; no Clifford algebra, no Spin group, no topology.
notes: NOT identified with an infinitesimal structure of SpinCore.SpinGroup: see CLAIM-B010, CLAIM-B011, OP-012.

type_or_definition: gBLie : LieSubalgebra R (Module.End R LorentzCarrier) with carrier gB
mathematical_interpretation: The Lie-algebra structure on gB; the bracket is the endomorphism commutator (THM-L013).
existence_note: Closure of gB under the commutator is proved (THM-L015).
notes: A Lie algebra of the intrinsic Lorentz sector, not of the intrinsic Spin group.

type_or_definition: wedge u v : exterior power 2 of LorentzCarrier; the bivector space is the Mathlib exterior square of the intrinsic carrier
mathematical_interpretation: The bivector space of the intrinsic carrier and its decomposable elements; six-dimensional (finrank_extPow2).
existence_note: The exterior square of a four-dimensional space; no extra datum enters.
notes: Kend u v is the skew endomorphism realising wedge u v.

type_or_definition: bivectorEquivSkew : (exterior square of LorentzCarrier) linear-equiv gB
mathematical_interpretation: The intrinsic linear isomorphism between bivectors of the carrier and Lorentz-skew endomorphisms.
existence_note: Bijectivity is proved (Phi_injective, Phi_surjective); it gives finrank gB = 6 (THM-L012).
notes: A linear equivalence, not a Lie-algebra isomorphism statement and not a statement about Lie(SpinGroup).
